mutations.name: a resolved variety row gates the resolve stage
kills: running a stage's checks declares every check either a gate or reported
resolve stage variety checks reports a repetitive resolve, naming its beats, and fails no gate
resolve stage variety checks reads the resolved profile's limits, and an unknown profile is reported, not gated

mutations.name: the resolved variety rows are not registered at checks:resolve
kills: running a stage's checks declares every check either a gate or reported
resolve stage variety checks passes every variety row on a varied resolve
resolve stage variety checks reports a repetitive resolve, naming its beats, and fails no gate

mutations.name: cue-resolution reads cut beats against words
kills: tts stage checks passes with a beat resolve cut, whose cue tts never voiced

mutations.name: the rewrite stage has no word-budget gate
mutations.find: { name: "word-budget", gate: true, reads: ["script"], run: (input) => draftWordBudget(script(input, "script")) },
kills: rewrite stage checks gates on a rewritten beat over the word cap resolve holds it to
